standard_prerequisites.name: The presentation of a quasi-compact algebraic stack by an affine scheme, and the openness and surjectivity of the induced map on topological spaces
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 6941-6945) as pointers to results of the chapter on properties of stacks
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the presentation on which the basis of quasi-compact opens and the stability under intersections are checked.

standard_prerequisites.name: The identification of fibre products of presentations with the intersection of the corresponding opens of the topological space
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 6955-6957)
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the intersection of two quasi-compact opens is again quasi-compact, using the quasi-compactness of the diagonal.

standard_prerequisites.name: The existence of a dense open gerbe inside a reduced stack, the bijection of points for a gerbe, and the spectrality of the space of a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked in the second half of the counted proof (source lines 6989-7003) as pointers to results of this and other chapters
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces sobriety to the case of a gerbe over an algebraic space, where the space is already known to be spectral.

core_obligations: Basis and intersections: from an affine presentation the proof gets that the quasi-compact opens form a basis, and for two quasi-compact opens it takes quasi-compact opens of the presentation mapping to them, uses the quasi-compactness of the diagonal to see that their fibre product over the stack is quasi-compact, and identifies the image of that fibre product with the intersection (proof lines 6941-6958)

Reduction to a reduced irreducible case: for an irreducible closed subset the proof passes to the reduced induced closed substack, checks that its diagonal is again quasi-compact by a factorisation argument through the diagonal of the stack, and thereby reduces to the case of a reduced stack whose space is irreducible (proof lines 6962-6980)

Reduction to a gerbe: the inertia of the stack is a base change of the diagonal, hence quasi-compact, so the existence of a dense open gerbe stratum applies and the proof may assume the stack to be a gerbe (proof lines 6982-6993)

Conclusion: for a gerbe over an algebraic space the topological spaces agree, the space is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by the gerbe diagonal statement, hence spectral, which gives the unique generic point (proof lines 6994-7004)
proof_roadmap: 取仿射概型 U 满光滑映到 X，则 |U| → |X| 连续、开、满 ⇒ 准紧开集构成基；对两个准紧开集 W_1, W_2 取 U 的准紧开集 V_1, V_2 映到它们，由 Δ 准紧得 V_1 ×_X V_2 准紧，其像正是 W_1 ∩ W_2 ⇒ 交准紧。
只需再证 |X| sober：对不可约闭子集 T 取既约诱导闭子叠 Z（先证 Δ_Z 准紧，化到「既约、|X| 不可约」情形）；因惯性叠是 Δ 的基变换故准紧，由稠密开 gerbe 层的命题可设 X 本身是 gerbe；设 X 是代数空间 X 上的 gerbe，则 |X| ≅ |X|，X 准紧且（由 gerbe 对角准紧）准分离，故 |X| 谱，得唯一 generic point。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the underlying topological space of a quasi-compact algebraic stack with quasi-compact diagonal is spectral (author lemma at source lines 6933-6938, label lemma-spectral-qc-diagonal-qc). The proof (source lines 6940-7005) first checks the two basis properties of quasi-compact opens, using the quasi-compactness of the diagonal to see that intersections of quasi-compact opens stay quasi-compact, and then proves sobriety: it reduces to a reduced stack with irreducible space by passing to the reduced induced closed substack and verifying that its diagonal is quasi-compact by a factorisation through the diagonal of the stack, and reduces further to a gerbe using the inertia and the existence of a dense open gerbe stratum, where the space agrees with that of a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space and is therefore spectral (proof lines 6941-7004). The two reductions, with the diagonal bookkeeping, are the content. H3.
